::: {#sol-bikeshare-weather}

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

##### R

```{r}
#| code-fold: show
# The sample mean of the hourly count for each weather, largest first.
bikers_by_weather <- bikeshare_raw |>
  dplyr::group_by(weathersit) |>
  dplyr::summarise(mean_bikers = mean(bikers)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_bikers))
bikers_by_weather
```

##### R (base)

```{r}
#| code-fold: show
# The sample mean of the hourly count for each weather, largest first.
bikers_by_weather_base <- tapply(
  bikeshare_raw$bikers,
  bikeshare_raw$weathersit,
  mean
)
bikers_by_weather_base <- sort(bikers_by_weather_base, decreasing = TRUE)
round(bikers_by_weather_base, 1)
```

##### Python

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
# The sample mean of the hourly count for each weather, largest first.
bikers_by_weather = (
    bikeshare_raw.groupby("weathersit")["bikers"].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
)
bikers_by_weather.round(1)
```

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
weather_best <- bikers_by_weather$weathersit[1]
weather_best_mean <- round(bikers_by_weather$mean_bikers[1], 1)
weather_worst <- dplyr::last(bikers_by_weather$weathersit)
weather_worst_mean <- bikers_by_weather$mean_bikers |> dplyr::last() |> round(1)
```

The [sample mean](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-mean) of `bikers` is largest for `r weather_best` hours, at `r weather_best_mean` bikes.
It is smallest for `r weather_worst` hours, at `r weather_worst_mean` bikes,
so `weathersit` is a promising [covariate](model-validation.qmd#def-covariate).

:::
